chunks: Hafs ibn Ghayath al-Nakha'i narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever intends travel, then let him travel on Saturday, for even if a stone were to move from a mountain on a Saturday, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, would return it to its place. And whoever finds needs difficult to attain, then let him seek pursuing them on Tuesday, for it is the day in which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, softened iron for Dawud عليه السلام.

key_terms.الْحَدِيدَ: iron, mentioned in connection with Dawud عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحَوَائِجُ: needs, requests, or matters a person seeks to fulfill
key_terms.سَفَرًا: travel or journeying from one place to another
key_terms.يَوْمَ الثُّلَاثَاءِ: Tuesday, presented here as a favorable day for seeking needs
key_terms.يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ: Saturday, presented here as a recommended day for travel

ai.seo_question: Which days are recommended for travel and seeking difficult needs in this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith recommends particular days for certain worldly undertakings, especially travel and seeking one's needs. It presents Saturday as favorable for travel and Tuesday as favorable for pursuing difficult matters, invoking the example of Allah softening iron for Dawud عليه السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2389 - Hafs ibn Ghayath al-Nakha'i narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):

"Whoever intends to travel should travel on a Saturday, for if a stone were to be dislodged from a mountain on a Saturday, Allah (swt), the Glorious and Majestic, would return it to its place. And whoever finds difficulties in fulfilling their needs should seek them on a Tuesday, for it is the day on which Allah (swt), the Glorious and Majestic, softened iron for Dawood (David), peace be upon him."
